latestVersion.changelog:
byted-seedream-image-generate 1.0.0 – Initial release

- Generate high-quality images from text prompts using the Volcano Engine Seedream models (versions 4.0, 4.5, 5.0-lite).
- Supports text-to-image, image-to-image, batch image generation, multiple artistic styles, and aspect ratios.
- Offers advanced options like watermark control, custom sizes, multiple output formats (PNG/JPEG for 5.0-lite), and web search tool (5.0-lite only).
- Provides detailed command-line usage and Python API integration.
- Includes a version selection guide and prompt engineering tips for best results.
